summary: Pool Wallet & Core Team System testing complete. Backend: 17/17 tests passed. Frontend: Pool Wallet card and Core Team badge verified working. Fixed 2 bugs during testing.
critical_code_review_comments: GET /api/pool-wallet/info returns pool_balance, core_team_count, pool_rate correctly
GET /api/pool-wallet/admin/balance returns detailed pool info with settings and recent transactions
POST /api/pool-wallet/admin/add-member correctly adds user to core team and invalidates dashboard cache
DELETE /api/pool-wallet/admin/remove-member/{uid} correctly removes member and invalidates dashboard cache
GET /api/pool-wallet/admin/members lists all active core team members
PUT /api/pool-wallet/admin/settings validates pool_rate (0-100%) and updates settings
POST /api/pool-wallet/admin/distribute triggers manual distribution (returns 'No balance to distribute' when pool is empty)
Dashboard API returns pool_wallet object with balance, core_team_count, is_core_member
Frontend Pool Wallet card displays correctly with Core Team badge when user is a member
Daily cron job at midnight triggers distribute_pool_to_core_team()
